text:
jordan.dev: heads-up — i'm kicking off deploy of model-router v2 to prod in ~10m. routing policy: canary 10% for 5m -> 50% for 10m -> 100% if green. main checks: p50/p95 latency, 4xx/5xx, token usage, qualit diffs. ci tag: docker:redwood/model-router:v2-20260215-7a9c

maya.ops: ack — i'll watch the prod dashboards and paging. which dash panels should we focus on? link your quick queries if you have them. https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/prod-routing

samir: i'm on rollback standby. rollback trigger: sustained error rate >0.5% or p95 latency >500ms for >2m. rollback method: flip ff:route_model back to v1. i'll be at my desk.

riya: i'll run a focused smoke set after canary. quick script i use locally:
```bash
# run a few short prompts to check outputs & latency
for f in samples/*.json; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d "@${f}" | jq '.choices[0].text' ; done
```

deploy-bot: Deployment event — model-router v2 canary start (10%) — build 20260215-7a9c

jordan.dev: canary live at 10%. initial metrics: p50 72ms, p95 210ms, errors 0.1% (mainly tokenization warnings). no alerts yet.

maya.ops: saw tokenization warnings in logs, adding to watchlist. cost panel shows ~+2% token usage for v2 canary.

riya: did 12 sample prompts — responses look semantically equivalent for 10/12. 2 had truncated tails compared to v1; filed short eval notes in #eng-ml-evals.

samir: standing by. if we hit rollback thresholds i'll call it and flip flag. otherwise i'll authorize next step after +10m.

jordan.dev: flipping to 50% now (manual ramp).

deploy-bot: Canary updated — model-router v2 now at 50% traffic

maya.ops: metrics after flip: p50 75ms, p95 230ms, error 0.15%. low-level token warnings persist but not increasing.

riya: queued minor fix (PR 4821) for tokenization normalization — doesn't block rollout but i'll keep it ready to ship if trend worsens.

jordan.dev: PR 4821 merged to staging; will hold for now. full promotion decision after 30m stable at 50%.

samir: all good from my side. no rollback needed so far.

jordan.dev: scheduling full rollout in 10m if metrics remain steady. will post final status then.

maya.ops: no objections — :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment completed — model-router v2 promoted to 100% traffic (build 20260215-7a9c)

jordan.dev: closing thread. summary: canary -> 50% -> 100% over ~35m; minor tokenization warnings observed, PR 4821 ready if needed, no rollback executed. thanks all for quick checks.
